protocol_warning: No reviewed public dataset natively contains the complete loop of Harness edits, downstream training, delayed human feedback, and rollback.
Streaming batches, delayed feedback, candidate branches, and held-in/held-out selection are imposed research conditions unless marked native.
An adapted run must not be reported as an exact reproduction of the source paper benchmark.

dataevolver.original_protocol: 20 seed examples; select 1k or 5k training samples from official training splits; compare Vanilla SFT, DataFlow-SFT and DataEvolver-SFT
dataevolver.lego_relevance: data-preparation alignment only; no native long-horizon session or delayed human feedback

harnessevolve.public_status: OfficeQA and SpreadsheetBench have public releases; CloudCoreNetwork-QA and Wireless-QA are in-house; SearchQA source must be pinned separately
harnessevolve.lego_relevance: Harness external validation, not direct Data-Centric RSI reproduction

curateevo.public_status: BFCL and tau2-Bench have official public sources; ACEBench-Agent release and license remain unverified
curateevo.lego_relevance: executable curation alignment after source/protocol review

datasets.name: HelpSteer2
datasets.size: train 20,324 records / 10,161 prompt groups; validation 1,038 records
datasets.limitation: Cannot alone support a natural long-horizon Data-Centric RSI claim.

datasets.name: The PRISM Alignment Dataset
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 for human-written text; CC-BY-NC-4.0 for model responses; verify provider terms
datasets.structure: survey.jsonl, conversations.jsonl, utterances.jsonl, metadata.jsonl; user_id and conversation_id links
datasets.stream_protocol: session batches can be imposed; delayed feedback is imposed
datasets.fit: best public preference candidate, but not a complete LEGO dataset
required_checks: never merge users into one preference stream

datasets.name: AppWorld
datasets.paper: AppWorld: A Controllable World of Apps and People for Benchmarking Interactive Coding Agents
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 repository; inspect bundled data terms before redistribution
datasets.structure: 9 apps, 457 APIs, simulated world of about 100 people; train/dev/test_normal/test_challenge
datasets.fit: strong Harness validation; not a human-preference primary
datasets.special_constraint: Test setup/solutions are restricted to protect benchmark integrity.

datasets.name: tau2-Bench
datasets.paper: tau2-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
datasets.release_to_pin: v1.0.1 or later explicitly recorded; v1.0.1 fixes banking_knowledge tasks
datasets.structure: tasks with agent tools and optional user-simulator tools; mock, airline, retail, telecom, banking_knowledge
datasets.fit: strong Harness and delayed-evaluation stress test; not a human-preference dataset
datasets.special_constraint: Results before and after v1.0.1 are not comparable.

datasets.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
datasets.size: 89 task directories visible in checked snapshot; execute the pinned terminal-bench@2.0 artifact
datasets.fit: Harness failure diagnosis/regression only; weak fit for data curation

datasets.name: SWE-bench Verified
datasets.paper: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-world Github Issues?
datasets.license: dataset card license must be checked before redistribution; repository MIT
datasets.size: 500 verified issue instances is the standard release size; verify release card at run time
datasets.fit: coding Harness regression, not preference/data-centric primary

datasets.name: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard V4
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 for leaderboard/training data per official README
datasets.structure: single-turn and multi-turn function calling; V4 web search, memory management, prompt variation
datasets.fit: CurateEvo/Harness method alignment; not long-horizon human feedback

datasets.name: SpreadsheetBench
datasets.size: 912 instructions and 2,729 test cases; Verified subset 400

datasets.name: ACEBench-Agent
datasets.native_signals: paper benchmark; official raw release not verified
datasets.stream_protocol: do not use until official release/license verified

datasets.name: CoAuthor
datasets.failure_feedback: accept/reject/edit behavior; rejection is not a hard negative
datasets.human_preference: implicit behavioral signal; target construction pending
datasets.fit: promising, not eligible for server yet

datasets.name: CloudCoreNetwork-QA and Wireless-QA
datasets.fit: literature context; do not claim reproduction
